title: State scan in five steps
statement: Let $Q,T,S$ be types with decidable equality. Let $M$ be a Boolean multi-tape machine with $k$ work tapes, let $\operatorname{upd}:T\times\operatorname{Option}(\mathrm{Bool})\to T$, and let $\mathrm{seek}$ be a two-work-tape Boolean machine with designated states $\mathrm{start},\mathrm{finish}$. For any input list $x$ of record symbols, four-tape configuration $d$, and optional state $q:Q$, suppose $d$ is in the record-step entry control state and tape 0, at offsets $-1,0,1$ from its head, contains the one-symbol word consisting of the state symbol encoding $q$. After five steps of the record-step machine, the configuration is $d$ with its control state changed to the running phase that skips the state symbol and carries record data whose stored state is $q$; neither verdict state has been reached before those five steps, and every work-tape head remains within distance one of its initial position through that time.
